name: 8085 Data Exchange
desc: This is a simple 8085 assembly language program that loads the data 8423H and 8596H in register pair DE and HL. It then exchanges the numbers and halts the program.

files.sketch.ino:
; Load the data 8423H and 8596H in register pair DE and HL.
; Exchange the numbers. 

; CODE:

LXI D,8423H
LXI H, 8596H
XCHG
HLT

; END OF CODE
